item.title: 【Requests】[REQ VID] - Search Nicki Minaj archives in HDTV
item.description:
I search for Nicki Minaj archives in HDTV. Like intervirews and performances. I have the Nicki Minaj interview on Watch What Happens Live, for switch.

I’d like to see what we have. A few days ago, I shared a rare file with another, and they were ungrateful to me.
